preprocessing.filter: 4th-order Butterworth 1--40 Hz SOS, zero-phase sosfiltfilt on each continuous run
preprocessing.artifact_policy: retain every trial and store artifact boolean; no silent trial rejection
preprocessing.evaluation_label_policy: Use public true_labels/AxxE.mat classlabel in valid-run/trial order; compare with embedded AxxE run.y whenever the embedded labels are valid.

channel_policy.policy: Exact name matches only. Missing target channels are zero-filled placeholders and are marked False in target_mask; they must never be used as measured signals. No spatial interpolation or fabricated renaming is used.
